gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.
Negative prefix for 'legal' is 'il-' before l: illegal.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
